role: Immutable provenance record for the historical published judging run. Created 2026-08-29 from repository artifacts only; historical verdict files are untouched.
judge_model: GLM-5.3-Flash (vision, via local sub-agent channel; no API key involved)
verdict_composition: 116 SenseNova reproductions (R1 60 / R2 30 / R3 26) + 30 reference baselines

resample_protocol.arbitration_rule: if a blind resample differs from the original verdict by more than the threshold in five-dimension mean, a third arbitration review is added and the per-dimension median of the three is written back

self_consistency.metric: maximum absolute difference in the five-dimension mean score between original and blind-resample verdicts
self_consistency.resample_artifacts: runs/judge-queue/round-1/verdicts-resample/ (9 verdicts; round-1 queue = 90 entries = 60 reproductions + 30 baselines, ceil(90 x 0.1) = 9)
self_consistency.coverage_note: archived resamples exist for the round-1 queue only; rounds 2-3 have no archived resample verdicts

source_blinding.protocol: task-context blinding: entries carry neutral content-hash IDs (entry-xxxxxxxx), provenance-bearing filenames/metadata are excluded from the dispatched task context, the judge prompt forbids source inference, queue order is a per-round deterministic shuffle (seed = sha256 of round), and verdicts pass schema validation plus a provenance-leak scan before storage
source_blinding.historical_limitation: controller-side artifacts (runs/judge-queue/*/manifest.json and the ledger 'judged' events) retained the entry-to-source mapping in the workspace; the historical agent workflow was source-hidden at the task-context level but was not filesystem-isolated
source_blinding.future_runs: build_judge_tasks.py --isolated writes the provenance manifest outside the judge-visible queue dir (runs/judge-private/round-N/); collect_verdicts.py reads the private manifest when present

generation.seed_protocol: deterministic stable_seed(case_id, round, k) with SEEDS_PER_PROMPT = 2; per-round comparison takes the better judged seed per case

unknown_fields_policy: fields not recorded by historical artifacts are omitted rather than guessed
